g.text: Solid arrows: logical calls; the processor runs inside each composed app.
Dotted arrows: build-time binding generation, compilation and composition.
Both final artifacts resolve the telemetry import and retain the MQTT handler export.
No shared Rust path dependency and no separate telemetry network service.
Production compositions use WASIp2 for Spin 4.2.6 / MQTT trigger 0.9.6.
The reusable component is also validated with the WASIp3-first build script.
Python credential generation and Mosquitto startup remain host-side deployment helpers.
